before: measured 2026-10-31: no standard setting; text 3.5, arrowheads 3 × 1.2, aligned dimension text, projection only as words and a small symbol, standard-specific GD&T rules and the ISO line target deferred by D394/D395

change.field: drawing.standard?: 'iso' | 'asme' — absent is byte-identical to before (91 outputs across 11 fixtures compared by the auditor)
change.presets: standard.ts table: text ISO 3.5 (ISO 3098) / ASME 3.0 (Y14.2); arrowheads ISO 3 × 0.8 (≈15°, ISO 129-1) / ASME 3 × 1 (3:1, Y14.2); dimension text ISO aligned above the line / ASME unidirectional in a break of the line (beside it when it does not fit); zeros keep the leading zero and drop trailing ones (metric, both); ISO 5456-2 projection symbol sized by the lettering; ISO 5459 line datum target (two X joined by a thin line) vs ASME phantom line; ASME warns on concentricity/symmetry (removed in Y14.5-2018)
change.api: the preset is an explicit parameter (presetOf(settings.standard)) through buildSheet, drawingIssues, placeDimensionLabels, toleranceSuggestions and the exported mark builders — no module state
change.chat: set_drawing schema standard enum iso | asme | none (none clears); per-turn budget unchanged 24,997/25,000
change.studio: sheet settings 'Standard' select (Not set / ISO / ASME) after Projection; one undo step; previews follow
